d:
Gameweek 6 of the MG Indian Super League had no shortage of action. There were 14 goals across six matches, from stunning curlers into the top corner to a cheeky panenka, a goal inside the first minute, late equalisers and penalties.
Whether it was a long-range strike, a clever finish or a dramatic comeback, this week had goals for every taste. Watch all the best moments from Gameweek 6 in one place, and see which one you’d serve up as your favourite.
